question: Test whether integer winding or edge saturation can authorize first upward odd balance and same-event hold.
assumptions: Aligned odd coordinates in the three orthonormal opposite-pair directions.
Positive odd stock, empty initial odd record, and common fixed oscillator rate for the exact OR result.
The single-coordinate obstruction assumes no independent phase source.
The candidate requires exclusive same-event actuation and access to aligned record coordinates.
target_exposure: First directed half-stock hold target established in C06 v0.16–v0.17
fitted_choices: Common-phase preparation, aligned readout and shared arbiter declared; no empirical fit

result: Completed winding is constant at the three witnesses. A fixed edge-local projection can miss populated odd directions. The OR of three directed pair guards is exact under empty-record common-phase preparation but can fire early outside it.
